description: The `channels/<id>` settings document. Absent or unreadable = default, never fatal.

projects.description: Project id to `conversation_ref` (a thread in Telegram).

stream_edits.description:
Whether a running turn's ack message is edited with the live text (`channels.stream_edits`
in the plan). Absent = on; it only ever applies to a channel that declares `edit`.
